No human evaluation was conducted in this paper, only automatic metrics and LLM evaluation

overall_notes: The paper focuses on mitigating hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). It evaluates image captioning tasks using automatic metrics (CHAIR, POPE, etc.) and LLM judges (GPT-4V/GPT-4o). The extraction was generally accurate with minor cleanup needed for duplicates and normalization.
